correctness.rationale: The determinant of Omega^H(A-zI)[w,V] factors as det(D-zI)*[(rho-z)det(g,B)+sigma det(h,B)] because V is invariant and residual perpendicular V,w. Gaussian unitary invariance and conditioning on B makes the ratio a quotient of independent circular complex normals. Its radial tail 1/(1+t^2) gives infinite q>=2 moments. Independent symbolic differentiation of the exact real-marginal CDF .5(1+x/sqrt(1+x^2)) gives median-of-three density 3/[4(1+x^2)^(5/2)]; SymPy exact integral computes its coordinate second moment 1/2. Real+imag variances sum to sigma^2 and centering gives (rho-lambda)^2+sigma^2=||(A-lambda I)w||^2. Median tails of k=2h+1 have order t^-2(h+1), giving threshold q<k+1. Finite sketch simulation not used as infinite proof.

Nakatsukasa–Tropp (2024) use oversampled sketched pseudoinverse; Gu (2020) treats Gaussian quotient probability, which is acknowledged. The exact invariant-spectator ratio reduction plus three-median residual-scale identity was not identified in read source sections.

Coordinatewise complex median depends on choice of axes; random root must be mathematically identified as non-spectator, not selected by a practical heuristic.
For Hermitian A, deterministic Rayleigh quotient already has bounded/possibly better error; practical superiority is not established.
